entries.title: Proverbs 6:1
segments: My son, [if] you are surety for your friend, [if] you struck your palms with a stranger,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:2
segments: you are snared with the words of your mouth, you are taken with the words of your mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:3
segments: My son, do this now, and deliver yourself when you have come into the hand of your friend; go, humble yourself and make your friend sure.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:4
segments: Do not give sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:5
segments: Deliver yourself as a gazelle from the [hunter's] hand, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:6
segments: Go to the ant, sluggard; consider her ways and be wise;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:7
segments: who, having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:8
segments: provides her food in the summer [and] gathers her food in the harvest.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:9
segments: How long will you sleep, O sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:10
segments: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to lie down;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:11
segments: so shall your poverty come as one who travels, and your need like an armed man.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:12
segments: A worthless person, a wicked man walks with a crooked mouth,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:13
segments: winking with his eyes, speaking with his feet, teaching with his fingers;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:14
segments: perversity [is] in his heart; he [is] always planning mischief; he causes fighting.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:15
segments: Therefore his calamity shall come suddenly; he is quickly broken, and there is no healing.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:16
segments: These six the LORD hates; yea, seven [are] hateful to his soul:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:17
segments: a proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:18
segments: a heart that plots wicked plans, feet hurrying to run to evil,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:19
segments: a false witness [who] speaks lies, and he who causes fighting among brothers.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:20
segments: My son, keep your father's commandments, and do not forsake the law of your mother;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:21
segments: bind them upon your heart forever, tie them around your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:22
segments: When you go, it shall lead you; when you sleep, it shall keep you; and [when] you awake, it shall talk [with] you.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:23
segments: For the commandment [is] a lamp; and the law [is] light; and reproofs of instruction [are] the way of life;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:24
segments: to keep you from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:25
segments: Do not lust after her beauty in your heart; nor let her take you with her eyelids.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:26
segments: For by means of a harlot [a man comes] to a piece of bread; and another man's wife will hunt for the precious life.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:27
segments: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:28
segments: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:29
segments: So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife; whoever touches her shall not be innocent.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:30
segments: They do not despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:31
segments: but [if] he is found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the goods of his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:32
segments: Whoever commits adultery [with] a woman lacks understanding; he [who] does it destroys his own soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:33
segments: He shall get a wound and dishonor; and his shame shall not he wiped away.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:34
segments: For jealousy [is] the rage of a man; therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:35
segments: He will not take any ransom; nor will he be willing if you multiply the gifts.
